project.description:
The repo's own demos, one module apiece.
A workspace is a thing you RUN, and until now there was nowhere to run one from: the shell has no main and no server, and is mounted by the studio's starter. A demo here is therefore not decoration — it is the first front door the workspace has had, and the only honest test that the stack stands up without the studio around it.
Nested rather than a repo of its own, because a demo that lags its subject is worse than none: these build in the same reactor and break in the same commit.
